title: The volcano breath
intro: In the story Lia feels anger rising like a volcano and lets it go down by breathing. The breath is learned with a calm mind, like a game, so it is already there in the hard moment: this activity is done without the tablet.

3-5.goal: Try the volcano breath when calm, to find it again when anger arrives.
steps: Sit on the floor facing each other and put your hands on your tummies.
Breathe in through the nose counting to three together: the tummy swells like the volcano.
Blow out slowly through the mouth, for a long time, like lava flowing down.
Do it three times, then get up and that's it.
materials: a cushion or a rug to sit on
preparation: Choose a calm moment, not right after a quarrel.
Try the breath yourself once first, so you can show it without reading.

supervision.note: Always do it together. During real anger don't ask for it in words: sit close, lower your voice and do the breath first.

alternatives: With a soft toy on the tummy that goes up and down.
Blowing on a feather or a scrap of paper on the table.
